correctness.rationale: Translate hub potential to zero, giving compact P_t={|x_i|≤t, |x_i−x_{i+1}|≤1}. The variance Hessian is positive definite, forcing maxima at vertices. For t≤1/2 all rim constraints vanish and balanced ±t signs optimize. For 1/2<t<1 tight components must touch ±t and then propagate integer differences, forcing only four levels ±t,±(1−t). A one-extreme-sign competitor has exact pairwise variance and is strictly worse by the displayed positive polynomial. With both extremes at least two bridge sites are compulsory; for even n the variance penalty per bridge plus mean square is minimized by exactly two opposite bridges. For odd n integral sign-parity bounds prohibit >=3 bridge sites and give residual mean |3t−2|. The t=1 limiting/polytopal argument and derivative identities cover boundaries. Independently exhausted all feasible FOUR-LEVEL candidate rim vectors n=4..7 at five rational t values, matching 20 exact rational optimum values; infinite real-parameter result depends on analytic four-level and exclusion proofs.
